mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without any regime condition.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% signals an ongoing monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates for equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 2.0), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong economy with tight labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 1.0 and UNRATE < 4.5), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid industrial production growth (INDPRO above 105.0) signals strong manufacturing output and corporate capacity utilization, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days in a supply-driven expansion regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances (INDPRO > 105.0), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without any regime condition.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, which typically leads to higher wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE < 4.0), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to Fed rate hikes and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.0), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a rapidly strengthening labor market, which typically leads to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances (PAYEMS > 147000 and UNRATE < 4.2), or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
